HNDFDS.NS.d: Hindustan Foods Limited engages in the business of contract manufacturing of FMCG products in India. The company offers extruded cereals and snacks, such as breakfast cereals, instant porridges, rice crispies; hot and cold beverages, and energy drink concentrates comprising carbonated soft drinks, tea, coffee, malt based foods, soups, glucose powder, and dry mix powder; and leather and accessories that consists of men's, women's, and juniors' footwear, and uppers.

ICEMAKE.NS.d: Ice Make Refrigeration Limited operates as a refrigeration equipment manufacturer in India and internationally. The company offers its products under the categories of cold rooms and storage, commercial refrigeration, industrial refrigeration, and transport refrigeration products under the Ice Make, Bharat, and Trans Freez brand names.

IDBI.NS.d: IDBI Bank Limited provides banking and financial solutions to retail and corporate clients in India. The company offers savings and current accounts, corporate payroll accounts, and fixed deposits; home, auto, education, and personal loans, as well as loans against properties and securities; debit, credit, and prepaid cards; phone, mobile, and Internet banking services; and investment advisory and capital market services, as well as lockers.

IDFCFIRSTB.NS.d: First Bank provides various banking products and services to individuals, businesses, and governmental entities. The company accepts various deposits, including non-interest bearing demand deposits, interest bearing demand accounts, money market accounts, savings accounts, and certificates of deposit, as well as commercial checking accounts.

INDUSINDBK.NS.d: IndusInd Bank Limited provides various banking products and services to individuals, NRIs, business owners, corporates, and government and financial institutions. It operates through Treasury Operations, Corporate/Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking, and Other Banking business segments.

INVPRECQ.NS.d: Investment & Precision Castings Limited is an India-based company engaged in the manufacturing of precision castings. The company's products are used in various industries including automotive, engineering, and aerospace. Investment & Precision Castings Limited is headquartered in Bhavnagar, Gujarat, India.

JETFREIGHT-SM.NS.d: JET FREIGHT LOGIST is an Indian logistics company, potentially focused on freight forwarding and related services. Specific details on their business model and offerings are limited. The company operates in India.

LINDEINDIA.NS.d: Linde India Limited primarily operates as an industrial gases company in India. The company operates in two segments, Gases and Related Products, and Project Engineering. The Gases and Related Products segment primarily produces and sells oxygen, nitrogen, and argon gases.

MICROPRO.NS.d: Micropro Software Solutions Ltd. is an Indian company that provides software development, technical services, and IT solutions, including the design, development, standardization, and customization of software across various industry verticals. The company also engages in the trading of IT hardware and software.

NAHARCAP.NS.d: Nahar Capital and Financial Services Limited, a non-deposit taking non-banking financial company, engages in investment/financial activities. The company invests in various financial securities, including equity, bonds, debentures, commodity, term deposits, and securities of various kind issued by companies, banks, mutual funds, and other authorities, as well as central, state, municipal, and local bodies.

ORTINGLOBE.NS.d: Ortin Global Ltd. makes and trades pharmaceuticals, drugs and intermediates. Hyderabad is its headquarters, and it dates from 1986. Formerly Ortin Laboratories Limited, it was renamed in June 2024. Its formulations come in tablet, capsule, syrup and dry powder form for areas such as diabetes, allergies, cardiovascular conditions, pain and infections.

POLYSPIN.NS.d: Polyspin Exports Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and export of cotton yarn. The company's products are used in the textile industry. The company is based in India.

PRAKASHSTL.NS.d: Prakash Steelage Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of stainless steel welded pipes, tubes, and U-tubes in India and internationally. The company also trades in stainless steel products. Its customers include a set of industries, which comprise oil and gas, power, pharmaceutical, petrochemical, sugar, dairy, automobile, desalination, etc. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Mumbai, India.

PURVA.NS.d: Puravankara Limited, together with its subsidiaries, develops residential and commercial properties in India and internationally. The company's residential projects include apartment complexes, villas, townhouses, plotted developments, and affordable housing projects; and commercial projects comprise retail and office premises, and mixed-use developments. It markets its projects under the Purva, Puravankara, and Provident brand names.

REGENCERAM.NS.d: Regency Ceramics Limited manufactures and sells glazed and unglazed ceramic floor and wall tiles in India and internationally. It offers glazed vitrified, parking, and heavy-duty tiles for high traffic areas, as well as imported and duro tiles, and tile highlighters. The company also exports its products. Regency Ceramics Limited was founded in 1983 and is based in Hyderabad, India.

SAILIFE.NS.d: Sai Life Sciences Limited works as a CRDMO (contract research, development and manufacturing organisation) in India and internationally, with services in pharmacokinetics, medicinal chemistry, contract development and manufacturing. Incorporated in 1999 and based in Hyderabad, it was formerly SAI Advantium Pharma Limited.

SAREGAMA.NS.d: Saregama India Limited engages in the sound recording and publishing business in India and internationally. The company operates through Music, Films/TV Serials, and Publication segments. The Music segment manufactures and sells music storage devices, such as carvaan, mini carvaan, music cards, audio compact discs, digital versatile discs, etc., as well as deals with related music rights.

SIKA.NS.d: Sika Interplant Systems Limited is an Indian engineering company specializing in the design, engineering, and supply of process equipment and systems for various industries. The company offers solutions for chemical, pharmaceutical, and other process industries. Sika Interplant Systems is based in India.

SIMBHALS.NS.d: Simbhaoli Sugars Limited primarily manufactures and sells sugar in India and internationally. The company operates through Sugar and Alcohol segments. It offers double refined white crystal, white, icing, and diamond shaped crystal sugar, as well as sugar sachets and cubes under the TRUST brand name; brown mineral, coffee, jaggery, and jaggery powder under the Sunehra brand name; and lower glycemic index sugar under the G-Low brand.

SIMPLXREA.NS.d: Simplex Realty Limited is an Indian real estate company. The company is involved in real estate development activities. Simplex Realty is based in India.

SRF.NS.d: SRF Limited manufactures, purchases, and sells technical textiles, chemicals, packaging films, and other polymers. It operates through Technical Textiles Business, Chemicals Business, Packaging Film Business, and Others segments. The company offers tyre cord, belting, coated, and laminated fabrics; and industrial and polyester industrial yarns.

SRTRANSFIN-ZK.NS.d: Sec Red NCD Sr.VIII represents a secured, redeemable, non-convertible debenture issued by Shriram Transport Finance Limited, belonging to Series VIII of the issuance; it is a debt instrument used by the company to raise capital from the public; Shriram Transport Finance Limited is an asset financing NBFC focused on providing financing solutions to commercial vehicle owners.

STERTOOLS.NS.d: Sterling Tools Limited manufactures and markets high tensile cold forged fasteners to original equipment manufacturers in India. The company offers standard, special, chassis, and engine fasteners for use in passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, two wheelers, farm and construction equipment, and off-roadways. It also engages in leasing of immovable property; and manufacture and trading of motor control unit used in automobile industry.

SWSOLAR.NS.d: Sterling and Wilson Solar Limited provides engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services to solar power projects. Its EPC services primarily include the design and engineering functions, procurement of raw materials and selection of vendors, inspection and audit, construction of the solar power project, and field quality monitoring services. The company also provides operations and maintenance services to third-party projects.

TBOTEK.NS.d: TBO Tek Ltd. runs travel distribution platforms in India and globally. It provides an online technology hub where clients book worldwide travel services sourced from suppliers such as insurers, cruise lines, transfer providers, car rental firms, hotels and airlines.

TIRUPATI.NS.d: Shree Tirupati Balajee FIBC Ltd. operates as a manufacturer and supplier of industrial packaging products, with a primary focus on the plastics industry. The company specializes in Flexible Intermediate Bulk Containers (FIBCs), also known as big bags or jumbo bags, offering a wide range of types including builder bags, tubular, U-panel, 4-panel, ventilated, flame retardant, industrial clean, food-grade, and UN certified bags.

UNICHEMLAB.NS.d: Unichem Laboratories Limited, a pharmaceutical company, manufactures and sells pharmaceutical products in India, the United States, and internationally. It offers pharma products that address various therapeutic areas, such as gastroenterology, cardiology, diabetology, psychiatry, neurology, anti-bacterial, anti-infective, and pain management; and active pharmaceutical ingredients. The company was founded in 1944 and is based in Mumbai, India.

VIYASH.NS.d: Viyash Scientific Limited, which began as Sequent Scientific Limited, is a veterinary healthcare company active in Europe, Asia and other markets. It develops and supplies finished dosage forms for nutrition, pain relief, parasite control, antibiotic treatment and gut health in livestock, poultry and pets. It also offers analytical testing and veterinary formulation services.

ZEELEARN.NS.d: Zee Learn Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates in the education industry in India. The company operates through Educational, Construction and Leasing for Education, and Training Manpower and Related Activities segments.

ZENITHEXPO.NS.d: Zenith Exports Limited designs, manufactures, and sells fabrics to fashion and home furnishing industries in India and internationally. The company offers a range of silk, velvet, embroidery, and weave, fabrics. It also provides industrial leather hand gloves, silk fabrics, and made-ups. The company also exports its products. Zenith Exports Limited was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.
